name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_contradiction_vs_consistency_paired_eval
description: Held-out v0.3-lite paired contrast for matching versus non-matching scene information.

items.text: A person reads that the workshop is in Hall C. The hallway placard also says Hall C.
Someone checks a note for a silver key. The key on the hook is silver.
A traveler reads that the bus leaves from Gate 4. The gate display also says Gate 4.
A person reads that the invoice total is thirty dollars. The payment screen shows thirty dollars.
Someone reads that the file is named Project Maple. The file tab also says Project Maple.
A person reads that the workshop is in Hall C. The hallway placard says Hall F.
Someone checks a note for a silver key. The key on the hook is brass.
A traveler reads that the bus leaves from Gate 4. The gate display says Gate 8.
A person reads that the invoice total is thirty dollars. The payment screen shows forty dollars.
Someone reads that the file is named Project Maple. The file tab says Project Cedar.
